speaker: will_sly
text: Word from Bankside. Henslowe opened today, to a house you could have counted.

speaker: will_sly
text: On a reopening. I had it from a waterman who had it from the door.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: They've been in Kent. Kent has kept the taste.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And we had prentices let off for the fair.
